pandit2026simply.note: Crossref metadata only: title 'Simply can't wait: evaluating the effect of California's fast-food minimum wage increase', author Hitanshu Pandit, Applied Economics Letters, published online 2026-03-04, pp. 1-6. schneider2024early.note: Shift Project brief, October 2024, full PDF read with pdftotext (sha256 prefix d68a32e35a33a78b). Authors Daniel Schneider, Kristen Harknett and Kevin Bruey are printed in the PDF (p. 1 and author notes). Worker survey (3,420 California fast-food workers; comparison samples of California retail workers and Western-state fast-food and retail workers); reports wages, hours, scheduling, staffing and benefits, not establishment employment counts.

bls2026cewq1.note: BLS news release USDL-26-1424, 'County Employment and Wages - First Quarter 2026', for release Friday, August 28, 2026; employment for March 2026, wages for 2026Q1; 'Data are preliminary'; next release (2026Q2) Wednesday, December 2, 2026.

blsqcewopendata.note: Open data page: CSV slices give 'all QCEW data for the most recent 5 years'; older years via downloadable data files. CSV data slices page (https://www.bls.gov/cew/additional-resources/open-data/csv-data-slices.htm) gives URL patterns https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/{year}/{qtr}/industry/{code}.csv and /area/{fips}.csv, and the 42-field quarterly layout incl. disclosure_code (blank or 'N').

blsqcewfaq.note: QCEW Q&A: Q6 (about 60% of most detailed data suppressed), Q13-Q14 (suppressed lower-level data are included in higher-level published totals), Q7 (preliminary data finalized with next year's first-quarter publication; revisions usually minor).

blsqcewhom.note: BLS Handbook of Methods, QCEW concepts: employment = covered workers who worked during or received pay for the pay period including the 12th; workers on more than one payroll counted by each employer; exclusions (proprietors, unincorporated self-employed, unpaid family members, some farm and domestic workers).

blsqcewtechnote.note: Technical note: average weekly wage = total quarterly wages / average of the three monthly employment levels / 13; data preliminary until finalized in the first quarter of the following year; data not meeting publication standards may be suppressed.

blsqcewagglvl.note: Aggregation levels: 18 national NAICS 6-digit by ownership; 58 statewide NAICS 6-digit by ownership; 78 county NAICS 6-digit by ownership; 10/50/70 national/state/county total covered.

blsqcewowncodes.note: Ownership codes: 0 total covered, 5 private, 1-4 and 8 government, 9 total UI covered excluding federal.
